n: Arm Raspberry Pi Pico Projects for Schools
t: A free project book with nine Raspberry Pi Pico projects for ages 16 to 18.
steps: Download the book or clone the GitHub repository.
Read Project 1 and the list of parts.
Buy a Raspberry Pi Pico and the sensors listed in Project 1.
Install the programming tools that Project 1 describes.
Ask IT to allow the tools on school computers.
Preview Project 8 and Project 9 before you plan the machine learning work.
